## PR 本文 (原文復旧 — devin-8ef8473e)

## Summary

REV25-JAPANESE: linguistic-quality pass over every user-facing Japanese string — terminology consistency, machine-translation smells, remaining English where a JA rendering exists, and two real-GUI layout clips. ~90 files touched, almost all single-word or short-phrase edits; meaning is identical everywhere (no semantic changes, no stored-value changes except display-side labels).

**Canonical terminology (normalized onto the dominant existing spelling)**
- evidence → `証拠` everywhere (was scattered across `証跡`/`エビデンス`/`証拠`)
- calibration → `校正` (was `キャリブレーション`/`校正`)
- recommendation → `推奨` (was `推薦`/`推奨`); `自動推薦`→`自動推奨`, `推薦可否`→`推奨可否`
- load/import → `読み込み`/`取り込み` (was `読込`/`取込`/`読み込み`/`取り込み` mixing 送り仮名 forms)
- physical room → `実室` (was `実部屋`); inbox → `受信ボックス` (was `受信箱`); provenance → `出典` (was `プロベナンス`)
- undo history → `アンドゥ履歴` (was `編集履歴`); aim → `指向性照準`/`音響照準`/`筐体ヨー`; treatment → `トリートメント` (was `治療`); problem domain → `課題領域`
- assignment noun form → `割り当て` (`機能割当`, `誤割当`, `割当未完了`, `面ごとの割当`); terse state label `未割当` kept
- collapsed spurious JA–JA whitespace (`撤去した棚 を削除` → `撤去した棚を削除`, `A と B` → `AとB`, paren-gloss leftovers like `（候補予算）`)

**Mixed-language residue fixed**
- `installation_handoff.py`: new `_PREVIEW_SECTION_REASON_LABELS` maps the 12 stored section-reason strings to JA for the handoff preview (previously rendered raw: `不明 — no exact CalibrationPlan authority is bound`)
- Header/label rows showing raw identifiers → JA: `['campaign','model','候補','readiness']`, `['validation','scope','residual','trend','sensitivity','repeatability','gate']`, `['候補','index','位置']`, `Nominal`, `objective`, `target`, `parameter`/`speaker` row labels, `Adaptive Plan` accessible names, `— AcousticTreatment —` separator
- `generic N60 measurementの存在だけでは…` → `汎用N60測定の存在だけでは…`; `'validated'→'検証済み'`, `'synthetic fixture evidence'→'合成フィクスチャの証拠'` label maps; `evidence:`/`solver:` field prefixes → `証拠:`/`ソルバー:`

**Layout clips (verified in real GUI, Mesa llvmpipe)**
- `system_expansion_widgets.py`: `speaker_title` lacked `setWordWrap(True)` → "追加スピーカー / チャンネル" clipped mid-string in the topology proposal builder
- `measurement_page_workspace.py`: 準備チェック table had all-Stretch columns → `ResizeToContents` on cols 0–1 so "サンプルレート 48 kHz"/"絶対SPL（レベル校正）" are fully readable

**Tests**
- New `backend/tests/test_japanese_terminology.py`: AST scan over every string literal in `backend/src/htdt` (docstrings excluded) asserting the retired spellings never return
- `test_installation_handoff.py`: preview assertions extended — section reasons must not leak `authority is bound`
- Existing assertions updated where the canonical string legitimately changed (`自動推奨`, `機能割り当て`, `を削除` without space, `検証済み`/`候補`/`古い` finding titles, `証拠` reliability prefix, `スピーカー` error regex)
- Test fixture strings that are *data* reverted to English (`Old Room`, `Second Project`, `(measured)`) — the transform over-localized them; runtime names stay verbatim

**Judgment calls**
- Left verbatim: entity/data names (`speaker-fl`, `UMIK-1`, library item titles), enum inputs users type (`magnitude_response` observable default, `native` fidelity default — changing the default would change submitted values), `Pareto`/`native` column values, `my-*` example slugs, `htdt.rectangular_geometry` capability ids, `REW`/acronyms, `advanced_lines` debug fields (`provider_evidence:`)
- `介入プランナー` kept (katakana `プランナー` consistent with `アダプティブプランナー` elsewhere)
- `着座席` → `座席` placeholder typo fix; `以前のPCの移行ファイル` → `旧PCの移行ファイル` to match the card copy above it
